notes:
Bugfixes:

- Site and IPTV long-check settings now share the same duration and end-action state instead of keeping separate values that could drift apart.
- PC Sleep, Save Log Only and Shutdown + Copy Log selections now apply identically to both Site Channels Check and IPTV Channels Check.
- Legacy mismatched Site/IPTV settings are reconciled on load so an existing end action is preserved instead of being silently lost.

Important:

- Dorcel playback, token handoff, predictive restart logic, One Channel playback, Check Lock, 65/125-minute timing, AlarmClock/watchdog, log-copy and shutdown implementation remain unchanged.
